backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles, admin-gated image uploads, and authenticated image retrieval using access control and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features, related files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose and functionality of all frontend source files.
frontend/.gitignore: Git ignore rules covering dependencies, build outputs, logs, environment files, IDE files, OS cruft, and temporary files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and utility setup defining OKLCH color variables, dark mode overrides, and global background/foreground styles.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point that mounts the React app and loads main.tsx.
frontend/README.md: Project overview describing architecture, tooling, and basic development setup requirements for the frontend.
frontend/scripts/REDEPLOY.md: Runbook describing prerequisites and steps for performing a clean redeploy of the app.
frontend/scripts/redeploy.ps1: PowerShell script performing clean dependency install, backend binding generation, frontend build, and backend deploy with logs.
frontend/scripts/redeploy.sh: Bash script automating frontend reinstall, backend binding generation, build, and deployment with timestamped logs.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component rendering the layout, category navigation, vinyl player header placement, HDDHub interactions, and category overlay behavior.
frontend/src/components/CategoryModal.ts: Empty placeholder file intended for a modal component implementation.
Truncated file containing the start of the category overlay component, likely handling display and dismissal of category details.
frontend/src/components/ElectronHoverLin: Canvas-based animated particle link between two DOM elements, updating particle positions and intensities in a render loop.
frontend/src/components/StudioComponents: Provides PortfolioShell and VinylPlayer components with asset fallbacks, audio playback, and background loading logic.
frontend/src/data/categories.ts: Defines a Category interface and exports an array of categorized portfolio descriptions.
frontend/src/data/categoryOverlayContent: Provides placeholder overlay sections with text and photo metadata for each category.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Initializes a backend actor using Internet Identity, manages reactivity with React Query, and triggers refetch on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity provider and hook using Dfinity AuthClient, handling login, stored identities, and status states.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhotoGallery.ts: React Query hooks for listing, uploading, and permission-checking images through the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets Tailwind base layers, theme CSS variables for light/dark modes, and defines custom utilities and animations.
frontend/src/lib/assetFallbacks.ts: Empty file placeholder for asset fallback logic.
frontend/src/lib/assets.ts: Provides asset URL resolution, placeholder SVG generation, and fallback chains for all image assets.
frontend/src/lib/assetUrls.ts: Empty file placeholder for asset URL definitions.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a helper function that merges class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app, sets up React Query and Internet Identity provider, and loads global styles.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters with session persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme extensions, color variables, animations, and plugins.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Vite configuration for React, environment variables, dev proxy, and path aliases.
project_state.json: Metadata describing project state, requirements, features, and architectural notes.
